every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 keeps its explanatory text card anchored and paired with the 3D scene across all frames, whereas Site 1 drops the UI card completely during transitions in frames 4 and 7, leaving large empty spaces on the left.

explains_the_project.reason: While both share the same industrial press and caliper metaphors, Site 2 keeps the explanatory copy visible during intermediate scroll steps in frames 4 and 7 so the visual transitions stay contextualized.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the exact same 3D models, materials, lighting, and grid floor across frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: Both use identical typography and card styling, though Site 2 maintains a persistent left-hand text column in frames 4 and 7 instead of letting the layout vanish mid-scroll like Site 1 (note both have a minor typo 'ONE20,001-LINE' in frame 1).

overall.reason: Site 2 delivers a more continuous and composed scroll experience by keeping the explanatory UI cards visible across every scroll position rather than leaving dead transition gaps.
